messages:
rachel: noticed a cluster of tenant complaints this morningthey think we're charging them twice for the same long-chat requests. console shows route=v2 (preferred) but backend traces show v2 timeout -> v1 executed. tokens show up under both models in realtime bars. :confused:

tim: ouch. is the extra billing because we charge at each attempt? I thought retries were trimmed in billing. any sample trace id?

rachel: trace id r-20260323-33: v2 attempt timed out after 1.8s (latency SLO breach) then we immediately routed to v1 and that produced the response. we emit token_count on every attempt, and the UI queries per-route totals so it looks like double consumption.

emily: two separate problems: (A) customer-facing UI misleads because it surfaces attempt-level metrics, (B) billing backend records attempts as charges. proposal: decouple attempt telemetry from chargeable attribution. ledger-based attribution service that collects attempts and writes a single attributed record when final route chosen.

pranav: agree. ledger shape: (attribution_id, attempts:list, final_route, tokens_final, settled_at). we should add header `x-rw-attrib-id` to incoming requests and to retries. ledger writes when response returned. Billing consumes settled records.

billing-bot: note: retrofitting billing will need a migration: prior invoices should remain as-is. for active tenants we can backfill unsettled attempts within a 24h reconciliation window. need product approval for credits if discrepancy >0.5% of monthly consumption.

emily: UI change ideas: show a combined "pending attribution" bucket in the per-model breakdown. Example console copy: "Tokens pending attribution: 3.4k These resolve within ~2 minutes after request completion." Add tooltip and a small spinner.

rachel: also want a tenant-level pin: "strict-version" toggle that locks routing to a version and disables automatic fallbacks. warn: enabling may cause more 5xxs. default OFF. add a tiny banner on enable: "You will be billed for attempts on pinned version only."

pranav: maybe better wording: "When strict pin is enabled, we will not automatically route to alternate versions on errors. You can still opt into manual retries."

emily: telemetry: emit `redwood.routing.version_decision` metric with labels {tenant, route, confidence_bucket}. For lower-cardinality, bucket confidence into [high, medium, low]. Also emit a trace tag `rw_version_attrib_id`. Sample traces at 0.5% by default.

pranav: infra considerations: attribution service must be idempotent and withstand retries. plan: put attribution in a compact K/V store with TTL (48h) and a flush job to materialize final records to billing Kafka topic. Ensure encryption at rest.

billing-bot: add requirement: ledger must include non-repudiation proof (request signature/hash) so billing can reconcile if tenant disputes charges.

rachel: rollout plan: 1) deploy attribution header propagation + ledger in canary (1% tenants), 2) switch console to surface pending bucket (read-only) for those tenants, 3) enable billing consumption of settled records in a shadow mode (do not legislate invoices), 4) after 2 weeks, flip billing to settled records. Also add an escape hatch flag to disable attribution on failure.

tim: who owns which piece? I'll take routing header propagation + trace tagging. Pranav owns ledger infra & flush job. Emily owns console UX + dashboard query. Rachel owns rollout coordination and runbook. Billing-bot: billing team will coordinate accounts reconciliation and credits policy.

emily: dashboard query sketch (PromQL-style): `sum by (version) (rate(redwood_tokens_total{tenant="T123",attrib_state!="pending"}[5m]))` with an additional panel for `redwood_tokens_pending{tenant="T123"}` so admins see unresolved tokens.

pranav: alerting: fire pager if >2% of requests for a tenant remain pending after 30m or if ledger write latency > 5s p95. Also log a metric for "attribution_mismatch_backfill" during migration.

rachel: legal/product note: document the strict-pin behavior in dev docs and add a short FAQ for customers about why tokens may appear duplicated briefly.

infra-bot: deployment scheduled: attribution-ledger v1.0 -> canary us-east-1 group=1pct.

tim: ok i'll open an RFC with the sequence, sample kinesis schema, and a canary checklist. tagging @pranav @emily for review. thanks all :thumbsup:
